completion_checks: Every required criterion has an observable verification method or explicit gap.
Expected results are independent of the implementation under test.
Execution conditions, cleanup, and evidence requirements are defined.
failure_modes: A criterion has no agreed observable meaning: blocked for that criterion.
The available seams cannot discriminate important failure modes: inconclusive.
